outcome: Proportion of newborn infants investigated for suspected Early-Onset Sepsis (EOS)
Proportion of newborn infants receiving antibiotic treatment for suspected EOS
cohort: The study included newborn infants born at >=35 weeks' gestation in a large tertiary perinatal centre during two distinct epochs.
finding: The implementation of the Neonatal Sepsis Calculator was feasible and safe, reducing the proportion of infants investigated for sepsis and those treated with antibiotics for suspected Early-Onset Sepsis.
